the women spies history
almost forgot

virginia hall

the gestapo's most wanted, with
a wooden leg she named "cuthbert".

noor inayat khan

a radio operator in occupied paris.

josephine baker

secret notes in invisible ink
on her sheet music.

nancy wake

the gestapo called her
"the white mouse".

mata hari

dancer, spy, executed in 1917.
